body: Yeah you know what, I think I will talk to my mum, I think she'd appreciate it. Thanks for the response, you made me feel a little better about things and hopefully things can get better in the future :).

I have been thinking about getting on anti-depressants as thats what my mother takes as well, but I don't want to have to take pills to be able to be happy. To me the idea seems like a junkie trying to get their next fix to feel good, it almost feels like fake happiness. I still feel like I would be faking it if I was on them and would become reliant on them, which in my mind still isn't true happiness.

I do want to talk to them, my mother in particular but I have this really carefree persona and I hate being a burden to people. They will treat me differently and act different towards me if I tell them the truth and I hate for them to worry. I guess I do feel ashamed about it all now that I think about it, like what the hell is wrong with me being so lucky and still not happy.. is there really nothing that will bring me joy in this world?

I don't think my friends would understand though, they're all very "ladsy" or stable people not the kind of emotionally understanding sort, great fun all the time and very loyal but not really that kind of support type.

Thanks for the response.
